def cost(state, key) do
  prices = Map.get(state, "prices", %{})
  dollars =
    state
    |> Map.get("calls", [])
    |> Enum.filter(fn c -> c["key"] == key end)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn c, acc ->
      case Map.get(prices, c["model"]) do
        nil -> acc
        price -> acc + c["tokens"] / 1000 * price / 100
      end
    end)
  Float.round(dollars * 1.0, 2)
end
top_spender:
def top_spender(state) do
  calls = Map.get(state, "calls", [])
  keys = calls |> Enum.map(fn c -> c["key"] end) |> Enum.uniq()
  case keys do
    [] ->
      nil
    _ ->
      keys
      |> Enum.sort_by(fn k -> {-cost(state, k), k} end)
      |> List.first()
  end
end
usage:
def usage(state, key) do
  state
  |> Map.get("calls", [])
  |> Enum.filter(fn c -> c["key"] == key end)
  |> Enum.reduce(0, fn c, acc -> acc + c["tokens"] end)
end
valid_key: def valid_key(state, key), do: is_binary(key) and String.trim(key) != ""
valid_model: def valid_model(state, model), do: is_binary(model) and String.trim(model) != ""
valid_tokens: def valid_tokens(state, tokens), do: is_integer(tokens) and tokens > 0
